description: This is a false-colour satellite image displaying a landscape dominated by agricultural fields and distinct linear vegetation features. Large areas appear in shades of red and magenta, indicating actively growing, healthy vegetation, typical for crops or grassland when viewed with a Near-Infrared (NIR) band combination. A bright green, narrow, linear feature runs diagonally across the image, representing "lines of trees and scrub" as defined in the document, typically between 10 m and 25 m in width and with a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of at least 0.5 ha. Parallel to this, a darker, possibly shadowed or non-vegetated linear element (dark blue-green/black) is also visible, which could be a river or a very dense, shadowed tree line. The imagery exemplifies features used in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) for land cover classification like CORINE Land Cover (CLC+).
